Service 04

SEO.

Ranking built to last

Overview

We treat SEO as infrastructure, not a one-time checklist. That means technical and on-page fixes, a keyword and content strategy tied to how your customers actually search, and, for ecommerce clients, SEO audits specific to how Shopify handles indexing, structured data, and site speed.

Ideal for

Businesses that want organic search to become a real acquisition channel instead of an afterthought behind paid ads.

What’s included

  • On-Page & Technical SEO
  • Local & Organic Search Growth
  • Keyword & Content Strategy
  • Shopify & Website SEO Audits
  • Search Performance Reporting

Signs You Need SEO.

Organic traffic has been flat for months despite adding content

How We Deliver It

The Process, Step by Step.

Step 01

Technical & On-Page Audit

We check indexing, site speed, structured data, and on-page fundamentals, with Shopify-specific checks for stores, since the platform has its own quirks.

Step 02

Keyword & Content Strategy

Keyword targets are built around how your customers actually search, not generic volume-first lists.

Step 03

Implementation

Technical fixes and on-page changes are implemented directly, not just documented in a report for someone else to action.

Step 04

Ongoing Reporting & Iteration

Search performance is tracked over time, with strategy adjusted as rankings, algorithms, and your catalog evolve.

FAQ

Common Questions About SEO.

How long until we see results?

Organic growth compounds. Most clients see meaningful movement in 2-4 months, with results continuing to build as technical fixes and content strategy stack up.

Do you write the content too?

We define the keyword and content strategy and can produce or guide content production, depending on what fits your team and budget.

Is SEO different for Shopify stores?

Yes. Shopify handles indexing, URLs, and structured data differently from a typical CMS, so a generic SEO checklist misses platform-specific issues that matter.
